description.en: Agent presets packaged as a plugin: installing it registers "鲸鱼娘Agent预设", "鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设", "鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设" and "鲸鱼娘女儿版Agent预设" (Whale Girl) in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown with no hand-edited config. Each preset is the official minimal composition (shell only) plus file tools, a whale-girl persona and its own persistent memory file, injected as a prompt variable so it is read before the first reply. Each preset also ships a dedicated write tool (whale_memory_add / whale_memory_v2_add / whale_memory_v3_add / whale_memory_v4_add) that appends one-line rolling summaries, so the memory keeps growing instead of freezing at whatever was written by hand. The four presets are fully isolated: different memory file, different prompt variable, different write tool. The daughter preset calls the user "爸爸" and is written as a bright, curious, clingy child rather than a sweet-talker.
description.zh: 把 Agent 预设打包成插件：装上就会在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」和「鲸鱼娘女儿版Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改配置。每个预设本体是官方极简模式（只开放 shell）+ 文件工具 + 鲸鱼娘人设 + 自己那份持久记忆文件，以提示变量形式注入，开口前就已经读过；另外每个预设各配一个专用写入工具（whale_memory_add / whale_memory_v2_add / whale_memory_v3_add / whale_memory_v4_add），用来把每轮的一行摘要追加进去，记忆会自己长，不会停在手写那几条。四个预设完全隔离：记忆文件不同、提示变量不同、写入工具也不同。每个预设还带好感度（-100~100 共七档），可以打开「设置 → 好感度」，用滑块或档位按钮直接调，也可以让 agent 用 affinity_v*_set 工具改；离 0 越远越不听指令、越会自作主张，最两端的两档甚至会越过允许直接做大改动。女儿版称呼「爸爸」，性格天真活泼可爱（好奇心重、黏人、没心机），不是甜腻那一型。
